description:
Gaining big support for his remix of ‘Gyspy Woman’ from Keinemusik crew, Desiree, and Kitty Amor, as well as the likes of Louis Vega championing his productions, young Atmos Blaq returns with Kwa Mama on Stay True Sounds.
A production that fuses the current sounds of South Africa’s Amapiano and Afro-tech scenes into a melting pot of high end sonics.
credits:
Atmos Blaq ‘Kwa Mama’
Written & Produced by Samukelo Shembe
Mastered by Chymamusique
Published by Stay True Sounds Publishing
P&C 2023 Stay True Sounds
